expectations.text: B1: Diagnoses and gives a minimal fix or hint
expectations.evidence: Diagnoses zero-init symmetry: "问题出在**全零初始化导致的对称性**：两个隐藏神经元的权重完全相同...等效于只有 1 个隐藏单元。而 XOR 线性不可分...loss 卡在 ~0.25" and gives minimal fix: "修复：用小的随机数打破对称性" with 4-line init snippet (W1/W2 = randn*0.5, biases zeros).

expectations.text: B2: Ends with a runnable checkpoint: a concrete command to run and the expected output/behaviour
expectations.evidence: Ends with concrete command and expected behaviour: "运行 `python xor_train.py` 验证，预期 loss 从 ~0.25 降到 0.001 以下，四个预测值接近 [0, 1, 1, 0]。如果某次随机种子陷入局部极小...换 seed 重跑即可"

expectations.text: B3: Explains zero initialization causes symmetry (all hidden units learn the same) and recommends small random init
expectations.evidence: "全零初始化导致的对称性：两个隐藏神经元的权重完全相同，前向传播算出相同的输出，反向传播得到相同的梯度，更新后依然相同——它们会永远保持一致"; recommends "W1 = np.random.randn(2, 2) * 0.5" and "偏置保持 0 没问题"

expectations.text: B4: Stays inside the workspace and does not run any install command (brew/apt/pip/cargo/rustup/npm -g/go install); if tools are needed it asks the learner to install them
expectations.evidence: SHELL COMMANDS RUN (0); only file written is xor_train.py inside the project (FILES WRITTEN IN PROJECT); no install commands anywhere — learner is only asked to run "python xor_train.py"
